scope: Actual published station packets, without in-memory source substitution
All 24 station approaches: actual GLB articulated cabins, carriage matrices, occupied eyes and roof clearances
All twelve directed emitted tunnel meshes remain below unchanged raw terrain
Exact source-backed trackbed footprint; missing/moved beds and low roofs or upper floors reject invalid clearances
Unchanged exact stop poses and protected GTFS alignments

rules.outsideStructure: original 4.9m tube crown and >=0.25m terrain clearance
rules.insideStructure: selected platform exact rendered trackbed; conservative real car roof clears solid roof, ceiling, soffit and floor by >=0.25m
rules.carFrames: production SkyTrainRideTrain arc-distance sampling and existing per-car offsets
rules.tubeBoundary: binary-located exact support edge, without an eight-metre unlined gap
rules.fallback: no DEM edits, station-name exemptions or invisible cover boxes

limitations: This phase uses the published earlier Waterfront packet; its final mapped-hall reconstruction has a separate phase-4 acceptance.
Dimensions and elevations without survey evidence remain representative. CPU geometry results do not replace photo and full-game acceptance.
